
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/morec/p/19091348" title="发布于 2025-09-14 15:12">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">命令模式的深度解析：从标准实现到TPL Dataflow高性能架构</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>命令模式是对一类对象公共操作的抽象，它们具有相同的方法签名，所以具有类似的操作，可以被抽象出来，成为一个抽象的命令对象。实际操作的调用者就不是和一组对象打交道，它是需要以来这个命令对象的方法签名，并根据这个签名调用相关的方法。</p>
<p>以上是命令模式的大概含义，这里可以联想到事件驱动，command和handler,也可以联想到AOP的思想。联想到数据流的操作我就写了个数据流操作类库。</p>
<p><img alt="Snipaste_2025-09-14_15-03-02" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202509/1099890-20250914150327873-2082862196.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="Snipaste_2025-09-14_15-03-15" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1099890/202509/1099890-20250914150353254-205267453.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>之前写了一些有关AOP的，但是感觉还是差点意思，补上这次的可能在项目中会弥补一些短板回来，就是灵活性。<br>但是该项目重点是数据流的处理，所以web端来实现只是一个例子，大量数据的处理最主要的是后台任务吧，通过接口调用只是一个实例展示。</p>
<p>有关数据流这块代码核心如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Common.Bus.Implementations
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 基于TPL数据流的高性能CommandBus实现
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 支持并行处理、背压控制和监控
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DataflowCommandBus : ICommandBus, IDisposable
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IServiceProvider _provider;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> ILogger&lt;DataflowCommandBus&gt;?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _logger;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> ConcurrentDictionary&lt;Type, Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>&gt;&gt; _handlerCache = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> ConcurrentDictionary&lt;Type, Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>[]&gt;&gt; _behaviorsCache = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数据流网络</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> ActionBlock&lt;DataflowCommandRequest&gt; _commandProcessor = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 背压控制</span>

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _maxConcurrency;
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 监控指标</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _processedCommands;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _failedCommands;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _totalProcessingTime;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DataflowCommandBus(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, ILogger&lt;DataflowCommandBus&gt;? logger = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>? maxConcurrency = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            _provider </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> serviceProvider;
            _logger </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> logger;
            _maxConcurrency </span>= maxConcurrency ?? Environment.ProcessorCount * <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            _concurrencyLimiter </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SemaphoreSlim(_maxConcurrency, _maxConcurrency);
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建数据流网络</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            CreateDataflowNetwork();
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CreateDataflowNetwork()
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建命令处理器</span>
            _commandProcessor = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ActionBlock&lt;DataflowCommandRequest&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> request =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                    {
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _concurrencyLimiter.WaitAsync();
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> startTime =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTime.UtcNow;
                        
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行完整的命令处理管道</span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ProcessCommandPipeline(request);
                        
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> processingTime = DateTime.UtcNow -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> startTime;
                        Interlocked.Add(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _totalProcessingTime, processingTime.Ticks);
                        Interlocked.Increment(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _processedCommands);
                        
                        request.TaskCompletionSource.SetResult(result);
                    }
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Interlocked.Increment(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _failedCommands);
                        _logger</span>?.LogError(ex, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Command processing failed for {CommandType}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, request.CommandType.Name);
                        request.TaskCompletionSource.SetException(ex);
                    }
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">finally</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                    {
                        _concurrencyLimiter.Release();
                    }
                },
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ExecutionDataflowBlockOptions
                {
                    MaxDegreeOfParallelism </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _maxConcurrency,
                    BoundedCapacity </span>= _maxConcurrency * <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                });
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;TResult&gt; SendAsync&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;(TCommand command, CancellationToken ct = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) 
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">where</span> TCommand : ICommand&lt;TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> commandType = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(TCommand);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> requestId =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Guid.NewGuid();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> tcs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> TaskCompletionSource&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> request = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> DataflowCommandRequest(requestId, commandType, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(TResult), command, tcs);
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发送到数据流网络</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">_commandProcessor.Post(request))
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Unable to queue command for processing - system may be overloaded</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tcs.Task.WaitAsync(ct);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (TResult)result;
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (OperationCanceledException) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                _logger</span>?.LogWarning(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Command {CommandType} was cancelled</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, commandType.Name);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ProcessCommandPipeline(DataflowCommandRequest request)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用反射调用泛型方法</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> method = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span>(DataflowCommandBus).GetMethod(nameof(ProcessCommandPipelineGeneric), BindingFlags.NonPublic |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BindingFlags.Instance);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> genericMethod = method!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.MakeGenericMethod(request.CommandType, request.ResultType);
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> task = (Task)genericMethod.Invoke(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>[] { request })!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> task;
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> resultProperty = task.GetType().GetProperty(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Result</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> resultProperty?.GetValue(task) ?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Failed to get result from task</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;TResult&gt; ProcessCommandPipelineGeneric&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(DataflowCommandRequest request) 
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">where</span> TCommand : ICommand&lt;TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取处理器和行为的工厂函数</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> handlerFactory = GetCachedHandler&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(request.CommandType);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> behaviorsFactory = GetCachedBehaviors&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(request.CommandType);
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建处理器和行为的实例</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> handler =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handlerFactory();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> behaviors =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> behaviorsFactory();
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构建处理管道</span>
            Func&lt;Task&lt;TResult&gt;&gt; pipeline = () =&gt; ExecuteHandler&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(handler, (TCommand)request.Command);
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 按顺序应用管道行为</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> behavior <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> behaviors.Reverse())
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> currentBehavior =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> behavior;
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> currentPipeline =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pipeline;
                pipeline </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> () =&gt; (TResult)<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ExecuteBehavior(currentBehavior, (TCommand)request.Command, currentPipeline);
            }
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pipeline();
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>&gt; ExecuteBehavior&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
            ICommandPipelineBehavior</span>&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> behavior, 
            TCommand command, 
            Func</span>&lt;Task&lt;TResult&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> next) 
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">where</span> TCommand : ICommand&lt;TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> behavior.Handle(command, next, CancellationToken.None);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> result!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception ex)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Error executing behavior {behavior.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, ex);
            }
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Func&lt;ICommandHandler&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;&gt; GetCachedHandler&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(Type commandType) 
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">where</span> TCommand : ICommand&lt;TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (Func&lt;ICommandHandler&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;&gt;)_handlerCache.GetOrAdd(commandType, _ =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Func&lt;ICommandHandler&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;&gt;(() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> scope =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _provider.CreateScope();
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> handler = scope.ServiceProvider.GetService&lt;ICommandHandler&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (handler == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">No handler registered for {commandType.Name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handler;
                });
            });
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Func&lt;ICommandPipelineBehavior&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;[]&gt; GetCachedBehaviors&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(Type commandType) 
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">where</span> TCommand : ICommand&lt;TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (Func&lt;ICommandPipelineBehavior&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;[]&gt;)_behaviorsCache.GetOrAdd(commandType, _ =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Func&lt;ICommandPipelineBehavior&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;[]&gt;(() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> scope =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _provider.CreateScope();
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> behaviors = scope.ServiceProvider.GetServices&lt;ICommandPipelineBehavior&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">().ToArray();
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> behaviors;
                });
            });
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;TResult&gt; ExecuteHandler&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;(ICommandHandler&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handler, TCommand command) 
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">where</span> TCommand : ICommand&lt;TResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handler.HandleAsync(command, CancellationToken.None);
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>&gt; ExecuteHandler(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span> handler, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> command)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> handlerType =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handler.GetType();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> handleMethod = handlerType.GetMethod(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HandleAsync</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (handleMethod == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Handler {handlerType.Name} does not have HandleAsync method</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> task = (Task)handleMethod.Invoke(handler, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>[] { command, CancellationToken.None })!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> task;
            
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> resultProperty = task.GetType().GetProperty(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Result</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> resultProperty?.GetValue(task) ?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Failed to get result from task</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GetCachedHandler(Type commandType)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> _handlerCache.GetOrAdd(commandType, _ =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取命令类型实现的ICommand&lt;TResult&gt;接口</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> commandInterface =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> commandType.GetInterfaces()
                    .FirstOrDefault(i </span>=&gt; i.IsGenericType &amp;&amp; i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span>(ICommand&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
                
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (commandInterface == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Command type {commandType.Name} does not implement ICommand&lt;TResult&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> resultType = commandInterface.GetGenericArguments()[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> handlerType = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span>(ICommandHandler&lt;,&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).MakeGenericType(commandType, resultType);
                
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 返回一个工厂函数，而不是直接返回处理器实例</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>&gt;(() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> scope =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _provider.CreateScope();
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> handler =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scope.ServiceProvider.GetService(handlerType);
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (handler == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">No handler registered for {commandType.Name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handler;
                });
            });
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>[]&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GetCachedBehaviors(Type commandType)

                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> behaviorType = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span>(ICommandPipelineBehavior&lt;,&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).MakeGenericType(commandType, resultType);
                
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 返回一个工厂函数，而不是直接返回行为实例</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>[]&gt;(() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> scope =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _provider.CreateScope();
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> behaviors = scope.ServiceProvider.GetServices(behaviorType).Where(b =&gt; b != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).ToArray();
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> behaviors!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 监控和统计方法</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DataflowMetrics GetMetrics()
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DataflowMetrics
            {
                ProcessedCommands </span>= Interlocked.Read(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _processedCommands),
                FailedCommands </span>= Interlocked.Read(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _failedCommands),
                TotalProcessingTime </span>= TimeSpan.FromTicks(Interlocked.Read(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _totalProcessingTime)),
                AverageProcessingTime </span>= _processedCommands &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> 
                    ? TimeSpan.FromTicks(Interlocked.Read(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span> _totalProcessingTime) /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _processedCommands)
                    : TimeSpan.Zero,
                AvailableConcurrency </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _concurrencyLimiter.CurrentCount,
                MaxConcurrency </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _maxConcurrency,
                InputQueueSize </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _commandProcessor.InputCount
            };
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ClearCache()
        {

            _behaviorsCache.Clear();

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Dispose()

            _commandProcessor</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Complete();
            _concurrencyLimiter</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Dispose();
        }
    }

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>其他普通或者批量操作就参考其他代码：<br><a href="https://github.com/liuzhixin405/exercisebook/tree/main/AOP/EventBusAOP/AopNew" rel="noopener nofollow">exercisebook/AOP/EventBusAOP/AopNew at main · liuzhixin405/exercisebook</a></p>
<p><br>一下是项目更详细介绍，如有错误多多指正：</p>
<div>
<div># CommandBus AOP 项目</div>
<br>
<div>这是一个基于AOP（面向切面编程）的CommandBus项目，使用TPL Dataflow进行数据流处理优化，支持多种CommandBus实现和实时监控。</div>

<br>
<div>## 项目结构</div>

<br>
<div>```</div>
<div>AopNew/</div>
<div>├── Common.Bus/ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 核心库</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; ├── Core/ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 核心接口和抽象</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── ICommand.cs &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 命令接口</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── ICommandBus.cs &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 命令总线接口</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── ICommandHandler.cs &nbsp; &nbsp;# 命令处理器接口</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── ICommandPipelineBehavior.cs # 管道行为接口</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── ICommandProcessor.cs &nbsp;# 命令处理器接口</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── ICommandRequest.cs &nbsp; &nbsp;# 命令请求接口</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; └── CommandBusType.cs &nbsp; &nbsp; # CommandBus类型枚举</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; ├── Implementations/ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 具体实现</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── CommandBus.cs &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 标准CommandBus</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── DataflowCommandBus.cs # TPL Dataflow CommandBus</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── BatchDataflowCommandBus.cs # 批处理Dataflow CommandBus</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── TypedDataflowCommandBus.cs # 类型安全Dataflow CommandBus</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── MonitoredCommandBus.cs # 带监控的CommandBus</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; └── CommandBusServiceLocator.cs # 服务定位器</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; ├── Monitoring/ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 监控相关</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── IDataflowMetrics.cs &nbsp; # 数据流指标接口</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── IMetricsCollector.cs &nbsp;# 指标收集器接口</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── DataflowMetrics.cs &nbsp; &nbsp;# 数据流指标实现</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; │ &nbsp; └── BatchDataflowMetrics.cs # 批处理指标实现</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; └── Extensions/ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 扩展方法</div>
<div>│ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; └── ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs # DI扩展方法</div>
<div>└── WebApp/ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # Web应用程序</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; ├── Commands/ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 命令定义</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── ProcessOrderCommand.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── CreateUserCommand.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; └── SendEmailCommand.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; ├── Handlers/ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 命令处理器</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── ProcessOrderHandler.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── CreateUserHandler.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; └── SendEmailHandler.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; ├── Behaviors/ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 管道行为</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── LoggingBehavior.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── ValidationBehavior.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; └── TransactionBehavior.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; ├── Controllers/ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# API控制器</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── StandardCommandBusController.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── DataflowCommandBusController.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── BatchDataflowCommandBusController.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── TypedDataflowCommandBusController.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; ├── MonitoredCommandBusController.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; └── MonitoringController.cs</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; ├── Program.cs &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 应用程序入口</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; ├── WebApp.csproj &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 项目文件</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; └── WebApp.http &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# HTTP测试文件</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>## CommandBus实现类型</div>

<br>
<div>### 1. Standard CommandBus</div>
<div>- **类型**: `CommandBusType.Standard`</div>
<div>- **特点**: 标准同步处理，适合简单场景</div>
<div>- **控制器**: `StandardCommandBusController`</div>

<br>
<div>### 2. Dataflow CommandBus</div>
<div>- **类型**: `CommandBusType.Dataflow`</div>
<div>- **特点**: 基于TPL Dataflow的异步并发处理，适合高并发场景</div>
<div>- **控制器**: `DataflowCommandBusController`</div>

<br>
<div>### 3. Batch Dataflow CommandBus</div>
<div>- **类型**: `CommandBusType.BatchDataflow`</div>
<div>- **特点**: 支持批量处理，适合大批量数据场景</div>
<div>- **控制器**: `BatchDataflowCommandBusController`</div>

<br>
<div>### 4. Typed Dataflow CommandBus</div>
<div>- **类型**: `CommandBusType.TypedDataflow`</div>
<div>- **特点**: 强类型安全，适合复杂业务场景</div>
<div>- **控制器**: `TypedDataflowCommandBusController`</div>

<br>
<div>### 5. Monitored CommandBus</div>
<div>- **类型**: `CommandBusType.Monitored`</div>
<div>- **特点**: 包含性能监控，适合生产环境</div>
<div>- **控制器**: `MonitoredCommandBusController`</div>

<br>
<div>## 使用方法</div>

<br>
<div>### 1. 依赖注入配置</div>

<br>
<div>在`Program.cs`中一次性注册所有CommandBus实现：</div>

<br>
<div>```csharp</div>
<div>// 一次性注册所有CommandBus实现</div>
<div>builder.Services.AddAllCommandBusImplementations();</div>

<br>
<div>// 注册命令处理器</div>
<div>builder.Services.AddScoped&lt;ICommandHandler&lt;ProcessOrderCommand, string&gt;, ProcessOrderHandler&gt;();</div>
<div>builder.Services.AddScoped&lt;ICommandHandler&lt;CreateUserCommand, int&gt;, CreateUserHandler&gt;();</div>
<div>builder.Services.AddScoped&lt;ICommandHandler&lt;SendEmailCommand, bool&gt;, SendEmailHandler&gt;();</div>

<br>
<div>// 注册管道行为</div>
<div>builder.Services.AddScoped(typeof(ICommandPipelineBehavior&lt;,&gt;), typeof(LoggingBehavior&lt;,&gt;));</div>
<div>builder.Services.AddScoped(typeof(ICommandPipelineBehavior&lt;,&gt;), typeof(ValidationBehavior&lt;,&gt;));</div>
<div>builder.Services.AddScoped(typeof(ICommandPipelineBehavior&lt;,&gt;), typeof(TransactionBehavior&lt;,&gt;));</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>### 2. 在控制器中使用</div>

<br>
<div>每个控制器直接注入对应的CommandBus实现：</div>

<br>
<div>```csharp</div>
<div>public class StandardCommandBusController : ControllerBase</div>
<div>{</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; private readonly CommandBus _commandBus;</div>

<br>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; public StandardCommandBusController(CommandBus commandBus)</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; {</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; _commandBus = commandBus;</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; }</div>

<br>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; [HttpPost("process-order")]</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; public async Task&lt;IActionResult&gt; ProcessOrder([FromBody] ProcessOrderCommand command)</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; {</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; var result = await _commandBus.SendAsync&lt;ProcessOrderCommand, string&gt;(command);</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; </div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return Ok(new { </div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Success = true, </div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Result = result, </div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; BusType = "Standard"</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; });</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; }</div>
<div>}</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>### 3. 专用控制器端点</div>

<br>
<div>每个CommandBus实现都有专门的控制器端点：</div>

<br>
<div>```bash</div>
<div># 标准CommandBus</div>
<div>POST /api/StandardCommandBus/process-order</div>
<div>POST /api/StandardCommandBus/create-user</div>
<div>POST /api/StandardCommandBus/send-email</div>

<br>
<div># Dataflow CommandBus</div>
<div>POST /api/DataflowCommandBus/process-order</div>
<div>POST /api/DataflowCommandBus/create-user</div>
<div>POST /api/DataflowCommandBus/send-email</div>

<br>
<div># 批处理Dataflow CommandBus</div>
<div>POST /api/BatchDataflowCommandBus/process-order</div>
<div>POST /api/BatchDataflowCommandBus/create-user</div>
<div>POST /api/BatchDataflowCommandBus/send-email</div>

<br>
<div># 类型安全Dataflow CommandBus</div>
<div>POST /api/TypedDataflowCommandBus/process-order</div>
<div>POST /api/TypedDataflowCommandBus/create-user</div>
<div>POST /api/TypedDataflowCommandBus/send-email</div>

<br>
<div># 带监控的CommandBus</div>
<div>POST /api/MonitoredCommandBus/process-order</div>
<div>POST /api/MonitoredCommandBus/create-user</div>
<div>POST /api/MonitoredCommandBus/send-email</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>## API端点</div>

<br>
<div>### CommandBus专用控制器</div>

<br>
<div>每个CommandBus实现都有专门的控制器：</div>

<br>
<div>- `StandardCommandBusController` - 标准CommandBus演示</div>
<div>- `DataflowCommandBusController` - TPL Dataflow CommandBus演示</div>
<div>- `BatchDataflowCommandBusController` - 批处理Dataflow CommandBus演示</div>
<div>- `TypedDataflowCommandBusController` - 类型安全Dataflow CommandBus演示</div>
<div>- `MonitoredCommandBusController` - 带监控的CommandBus演示</div>

<br>
<div>### 监控控制器</div>

<br>
<div>- `MonitoringController` - 实时监控和SSE数据流</div>
<div>&nbsp; - `GET /api/Monitoring/dashboard` - 监控面板</div>
<div>&nbsp; - `GET /api/Monitoring/stream` - SSE实时数据流</div>
<div>&nbsp; - `GET /api/Monitoring/metrics` - 获取当前指标</div>

<br>
<div>## 示例请求</div>

<br>
<div>### 处理订单</div>

<br>
<div>```json</div>
<div>POST /api/TypedDataflowCommandBus/process-order</div>
<div>Content-Type: application/json</div>

<br>
<div>{</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; "product": "笔记本电脑",</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; "quantity": 2,</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; "priority": 1</div>
<div>}</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>### 创建用户</div>

<br>
<div>```json</div>
<div>POST /api/TypedDataflowCommandBus/create-user</div>
<div>Content-Type: application/json</div>

<br>
<div>{</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; "name": "张三",</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; "email": "zhangsan@example.com",</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; "age": 25</div>
<div>}</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>### 发送邮件</div>

<br>
<div>```json</div>
<div>POST /api/MonitoredCommandBus/send-email</div>
<div>Content-Type: application/json</div>

<br>
<div>{</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; "to": "user@example.com",</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; "subject": "测试邮件",</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; "body": "这是一封测试邮件"</div>
<div>}</div>
<div>```</div>

<br>
<div>## 运行项目</div>

<br>
<div>1. 克隆项目到本地</div>
<div>2. 在项目根目录运行：</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp;```bash</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp;dotnet build</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp;dotnet run --project WebApp</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp;```</div>
<div>3. 访问 `https://localhost:5056` 查看Swagger文档</div>
<div>4. 访问 `https://localhost:5056/api/Monitoring/dashboard` 查看监控面板</div>

<br>
<div>## 技术特性</div>

<br>
<div>- **多种CommandBus实现**: 支持标准、Dataflow、批处理、类型安全、监控等多种实现</div>
<div>- **枚举驱动选择**: 通过枚举类型轻松切换不同的CommandBus实现</div>
<div>- **AOP支持**: 内置日志、验证、事务等管道行为</div>
<div>- **实时监控**: 支持SSE实时数据流和性能指标监控</div>
<div>- **类型安全**: 强类型命令和处理器，编译时类型检查</div>
<div>- **高并发**: 基于TPL Dataflow的异步并发处理</div>
<div>- **批量处理**: 支持批量命令处理，提高吞吐量</div>
<div>- **依赖注入**: 完整的DI支持，易于测试和扩展</div>

<br>
<div>## 扩展指南</div>

<br>
<div>### 添加新的CommandBus实现</div>

<br>
<div>1. 实现`ICommandBus`接口</div>
<div>2. 在`ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddAllCommandBusImplementations`中注册</div>
<div>3. 创建对应的控制器</div>

<br>
<div>### 添加新的管道行为</div>

<br>
<div>1. 实现`ICommandPipelineBehavior&lt;TCommand, TResult&gt;`接口</div>
<div>2. 在`Program.cs`中注册服务</div>
<div>3. 行为将自动应用到所有命令处理</div>

<br>
<div>### 添加新的命令和处理器</div>

<br>
<div>1. 在`Commands`目录中定义命令</div>
<div>2. 在`Handlers`目录中实现处理器</div>
<div>3. 在`Program.cs`中注册服务</div>

<br>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
